subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice lane alignment & early-pay pilot request
messages:
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@horizonai.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@horizonai.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding and payment timing

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're starting HorizonAI's onboarding for several new vendors and wanted to check Redwood's preferred PO and invoice flow so we can map payments into our ERP. Two items from our side:

1) Our standard AP cadence is Net 60 due to monthly consolidation. Would you accept Net 60 for the first 90 days while we finalize our supplier setup?
2) We are open to an early-pay program if Redwood offers a discounting option — what rates and enrollment steps would you require?

If you can send the vendor intake form and a stub of the early-pay term sheet, I'll circulate on our side. Goal: confirm PO routing and payment lane this week so we can kick off PO creation.

Best,
Tom Bennett
Head of Procurement, HorizonAI
T: +1 415 555 0123
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@horizonai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and payment timing

Tom — thanks for the note and context. Happy to align quickly. A few quick answers up front:

- We can provisionally accept Net 60 for the first month while your vendor portal is live, but our standard terms for new commercial partners are Net 30 or Net 45 depending on customer tier.
- We offer an early-pay program (voluntary) that provides a 1% discount for payments within 15 days and a 2% early-pay option for committed pilots — both require a signed early-pay addendum.

I've looped in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Karthik (Procurement) to share the onboarding checklist and the required forms. We'll attach the vendor intake and W-9 for your AP team.

Proposed next steps:
- Horizon sends vendor legal name and remit address (Tom)
- Redwood sends intake form + early-pay term sheet (Marissa)
- Confirm PO routing and who will be listed as invoice recipient in your ERP (AP)

I'll schedule a short call if helpful.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@horizonai.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding and payment timing

Tom — attaching the intake pack and our standard W-9 so you can drop into AP. Attachment stubs below:
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable vendor intake — legal name, tax ID, remit address, banking/ACH details)
- redwood_w9.pdf (company tax doc)
- earlypay_term_sheet.pdf (summary of discount levels and enrollment mechanics)

Operational notes:
- If Horizon requires Net 60 as an absolute by policy, we can provisionally accept Net 60 for the first 30–60 days; however, Net 45 is our preferred SLA for partners at your scale. Net 30 is standard once account setup and credit verification complete.
- Early-pay enrollment: AP signs the addendum and returns via DocuSign. Early-pay applies per-invoice; enrollment doesn't change PO acceptance but requires an AP contact and billing email.

Can you confirm: remit email, preferred invoice recipient (AP mailbox or direct PO contact), and whether you want to pilot the 2% early-pay program or enroll in the standard 1% within-15-day option?

Thanks — I can get the DocuSign ready if you confirm.

— Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, tom.bennett@horizonai.com
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding and payment timing

Tom — quick note from procurement: we generally prefer Net 45 for new commercial vendors where possible; Net 60 creates longer DSO exposure. If Horizon's AP policy is fixed on Net 60, would you consider a compromise: Net 45 standard with an early-pay opt-in (1% @ 15 days) to help accelerate cash conversion? Alternatively, we can set Net 60 for the first 60 days and move to Net 45 after the pilot.

If you want to pilot the 2% early-pay, we need a brief MOP (mutual action plan) that defines invoice volume/expectation and a three-month enrollment window. I can draft that if you're interested.

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@horizonai.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, ap <ap@horizonai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and payment timing

Thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility. HorizonAI can do the following:

- We'll set vendor setup to Net 45 for Redwood starting with our initial PO batch. Policy change approved for this vendor.
- We'd like to pilot the 2% early-pay program for the first 3 months on net invoices where we can guarantee 30-day processing. Please send the MOP and the DocuSign early-pay addendum and we'll route to AP.

Action items I see:
1) Horizon to return completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and remit details (Tom) — target EOD Thu 3/11
2) Redwood to send DocuSign for earlypay_term_sheet and mutual action plan (Marissa/Karthik)
3) Confirm PO routing and invoice recipient once vendor form is received (AP team)

I'll reply once forms are submitted.

Best,
Tom
[Attachment stubs referenced in thread]
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable)
- redwood_w9.pdf (pdf)
- earlypay_term_sheet.pdf (summary)
- docusign_mutual_action_plan.pdf (DocuSign link pending)
